description: This file defines an interface IStream and a template class StreamType that extends a base stream class with additional functionality, including methods for opening, closing, and triggering streams, as well as querying their state.

classes.name: IStream
classes.description: An interface for stream objects, providing methods to check if the stream is open or closed, retrieve local and remote identifiers, open and close the stream with a wait time, and trigger the stream.

classes.name: StreamType
classes.description: A template class that extends a base stream class with additional interface methods for managing stream state and actions.

methods.name: IStream::~IStream
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IStream interface.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::StreamType
methods.description: Constructor template that forwards arguments to the base stream class.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the underlying base stream is open.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the underlying base stream is closed.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::LocalId
methods.description: Retrieves the local identifier from the base stream.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::RemoteId
methods.description: Retrieves the remote identifier from the base stream.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::Open
methods.description: Opens the stream with a specified wait time.

methods.name: StreamType<BASESTREAM>::Close
methods.description: Closes the stream with a specified wait time.
